preconditions.description: S is a string and K is an integer.
Length of S is between 1 and 10^5, and K is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalnum() or c == '-' for c in S)
preconditions.description: S consists only of alphanumeric characters and dashes.

postconditions.description: The output is the groups joined by dashes, where groups is the list of reformatted segments.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() or c.isdigit() for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: All letters in the output are uppercase; digits remain unchanged.
Dashes appear exactly between consecutive groups, with no leading, trailing, or consecutive dashes.

postconditions.expression: len(groups) >= 1 and all(len(g) == K for g in groups[1:]) and 1 <= len(groups[0]) <= K
postconditions.description: There is at least one group; all groups except the first have exactly K characters; the first group has between 1 and K characters.

postconditions.expression: return_value.replace('-', '') == ''.join(c.upper() for c in S if c.isalnum())
postconditions.description: Removing dashes from the output yields the uppercase version of all alphanumeric characters from S in their original relative order.
